spec.spec: [Package] Name="ryans_quick_drop_shortcuts" Version="0.3.0.23" Release="" ID=eadbe0b800bab5b2eda58c3c833c3ab1 File Format="vip" Format Version="2017" Display Name="Ryans Quick Drop Shortcuts" [Description] Description="Ryan's Quick Drop Shortcut Plugins and Tools Plugins for clean code...\0A\0AQuick Drop Plugins:\0ACtrl-A: Arrange Diagram Aligns the selected diagram objects to the adjacent terminal position. Created for OCD developers like myself, you will have the cleanest looking block daigram of your peers. By default the objects are arranged Left-to-Right, hold Shift to sort Right-to-Left. The Bottom-Left and Bottom-Right terminals take priority when vertically arranging objects. If no diagram objects are selected, this will align the control and indicator terminals to the outer most horizontal terminal positions.\0A\0ACtrl-S: Execute Script Use the Quick Drop Textbox to execute a series of VI scripts on the selected objects. For example: Ctrl-Space + u16 hb rx + Ctrl-S = Change to U16, Hide Inc/Dec Buttons, Show Radix in Hex. Add you own plugins to QuickDrop\\plugins\\_Script. I'm getting bored explaining this, just refer to the built-in help: Ctrl-Space + type "help" + Ctrl-S\0A\0ACtrl-E: Resize Window Resizes the panel or diagram window to content to minimize wasted space.\0A\0ATools Menu Plugins:\0ATools > Project Properties Mirrors the Project Explorer tree to display a side-by-side comparison of any VI property for quality assurance purposes. For example, use this tool to help identify which VI's in the active project still contain compiled code ('Contains Compiled Code?') or missing descriptions ('VI Description') or missing help links ('Help:Web URL Link'). See the right-click menus for actions to filter by value or open the VI's to fix."
